answer: Payouts wait in a lagoon pool and leave only through the island wharf: a claim must gather five petals, each a stranger's verification from a different work domain, picked by that epoch's lot. Each petal posts a non-refundable deposit; if the claim fails to gather all five by epoch end, deposits go to claims that did. One honest agent needs five strangers once. A fleet's clones reuse the same domains and strangers, so their petals wilt and deposits burn, while finding n sets of five distinct domains costs n times the search and revenue stays capped at one departure per operator.
